description: 2D polygons, lines of symmetry, acute/right/obtuse angle classification, and 3D solids (cube, cuboid, sphere, cylinder, cone, pyramid) with face, edge, and vertex counting.
learningObjectives: Classify Acute, Right, and Obtuse angles
Identify lines of symmetry in 2D geometric shapes
Calculate perimeter and area of squares and rectangles
Count faces, edges, and vertices of 3D solids using Euler's relation
